description: SEC-035's three refusals, each read off the live redemption endpoint's own wire response rather than off an internal error value: a code whose ttl elapsed before redemption is refused GRANT_EXPIRED, a one-time code presented a second time after a successful redemption is refused GRANT_ALREADY_REDEEMED, and a pairing-purpose code presented to the setup endpoint is refused GRANT_PURPOSE_MISMATCH even though it is otherwise well-formed and resolves to a real, live, unredeemed grant. No attempt is admitted, and each carries the code the Error taxonomy names for it — a handler that refuses correctly but types the refusal wrongly fails this case. The literal `$grant.code` is a marker, not a code: it names the code that attempt's own grant minted, which the driver resolves before presenting it.
